text: Disconnect the black negative (-ve) terminal first, then the red positive (+ve) terminal. When refitting, connect the red positive (+ve) terminal first, then the black negative (-ve) terminal. Watch out: Keep the red (+ve) and black (-ve) cables firmly connected to their battery terminals. If they are not, the motorcycle's electrical system may be damaged.
